description: This file contains utility functions for handling DNS names, including validation, conversion between dotted string format and network wire format, and URL canonicalization, within the net::dns_names_util namespace.

methods.name: IsValidDnsName
methods.description: Checks if a DNS name in dotted form is valid using DottedNameToNetwork.

methods.name: IsValidDnsRecordName
methods.description: Validates if a DNS record name is valid, not localhost, and not an IP literal.

methods.name: DottedNameToNetwork
methods.description: Converts a dotted DNS name to its network wire format if valid.

methods.name: NetworkToDottedName
methods.description: Converts network wire format DNS name to dotted string representation.

methods.name: UrlCanonicalizeNameIfAble
methods.description: Returns a canonicalized URL host name if possible, otherwise original.
